slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review states that rural registry offices in Sudan register births mainly on paper at the point of service: paper birth notices from hospitals or midwives go to local civil registry centres, where events are recorded manually before electronic transmission to regional and central databases; it gives no date for this, so its publication date is used.

systems.tiers: local civil registry centres record manually and transmit electronically to regional and central databases; national aggregation with biometrics and national ID numbers under the 2011 Civil Registration Act
used for mass registration, including remote areas
named as a recent plan (2025), not implemented in rural areas
